messages:
jen: heads-up, deploybot paused the canary for rollout-2026-04-12 — p95 spike. thinking manual vs auto rollback.

deploybot: rollout paused for rollout-2026-04-12 (canary). metrics: p95=2300ms (SLO 1200ms), error_rate delta +1.6%, requests dropped 8%. Suggested action: staged unwind or fallback to v2.13.8.

sam: can we pin dedicated pools first? need to make sure enterprise tenants not affected.

maria: agree with pinned for dedicated — but for public hosted traffic I'd prefer targeted canary rollback only.

ops_lead: timeline? change window still open til 05:00 UTC. we should avoid full revert unless unavoidable.

eng_oncall: proposal: manual rollback for canary slice only, monitor p50/p95 and errors for 10m, then decide. thresholds: p95 < 1.3s and error_rate delta < 0.5%.

ryan: I can run the rollback if we agree. command I'm going to use:
```
redwood deploy rollback --target rollout-2026-04-12 --scope canary --to v2.13.8 --dry-run=false
```

sam: after rollback, we need a release note blurb and a quick customer note for dedicated accounts. I can draft the blurb.

maria: please include what we measured and that we reverted canary only. short blurb: "Canary rollout for 2026-04-12 temporarily rolled back due to latency regression; no dedicated customer impact. Continuing investigation."

ops_lead: assign comms: sam -> release notes, jen -> alert #customers (for dedicated customers), ryan -> execute rollback, eng_oncall -> monitor and report.

jen: tagging @deploybot to run staged unwind once ryan confirms.

deploybot: ack. waiting for operator confirmation to execute staged unwind (canary). runbook: https://internal/runbooks/rollbacks#staged-unwind.

ryan: executing now. will post start/finish timestamps.

ryan: START rollback 3456007922.

eng_oncall: monitoring metrics now. initial p95 back to 1.15s after rollback, errors down to baseline. continuing 10m watch.

jen: great. sam plz paste short release note here when ready.

sam: release note draft: "We temporarily rolled back the canary portion of the 2026-04-12 rollout due to a latency regression observed in early canary telemetry. The rollback affected only canary traffic; dedicated/reserved pools were pinned and experienced no disruption. Root cause investigation underway."

maria: add note: "customers on Dedicated who saw any increased latency should reach out to support@redwood.ai"

ops_lead: confirm: no SLA incidents to open yet, keep on-call path hot if regression reappears.

ryan: FINISH rollback 3456007933. canary back to v2.13.8. logs: /var/logs/deploys/rollout-2026-04-12/3456007933.log

eng_oncall: 10m watch complete. metrics stable. moving to postmortem triage channel.

jen: thanks team. follow-up: eng to file RCA ticket, release notes + customer note go out in next 30m.

sam: will send notes and update changelog.

maria: closing thread once comms sent. :thumbsup:
